description: This file declares interfaces and callback functions for the PduR module, which is part of an AUTOSAR-based communication stack. It includes type definitions, callback registration functions, initialization, transmission, and indication functions, as well as constants for include guards.

methods.name: PduR_RegisterRxIndicationCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for receive indications from the COM layer.

methods.name: PduR_RegisterTxConfirmationCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for transmit confirmation from the COM layer.

methods.name: PduR_CanIfTransmit
methods.description: Sends a PDU via the CAN Interface.

methods.name: PduR_CanIfRxIndication
methods.description: Callback invoked when a PDU is received via CAN.

methods.name: PduR_CanIfTxConfirmation
methods.description: Callback invoked upon successful transmission of a PDU via CAN.

ctags.name: PduR_RxIndicationCbkType
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*PduR_RxIndicationCbkType)(uint8 pduId, const uint8* SduPtr, uint8 length);$/
